description: South Korea year-end settlement for someone who left a job mid-2026 and was not re-employed that year: compares the employer's settlement in the leaving month (self only, social insurance, standard credit) with the May 2027 income tax filing that adds dependants, card spending, medical, education, donation, rent and pension savings. Returns both refunds (incl. local tax), the extra refund from filing, the items that made the difference and the filing deadline. Estimate only.

debit.description: Debit card and cash receipts (full year)

creditChildren.description: Children eligible for the child tax credit

medicalSpecific.description: Medical expenses for self, 65+, disabled, under 6

rent.description: Monthly rent paid (eligible homeless head of household)

healthEmployment.description: Health, long-term care and employment insurance paid (employee share)

salaryToDate.description: Total taxable pay from January to the leaving month (KRW)

withheld.description: Income tax already withheld (national, excluding local tax)
